conversation.transcript:
Student: Hi, I heard there’s a new study group starting this week.
Advisor: Yes, we’re organizing one for biology students. Are you interested?
Student: Absolutely! When does it meet?
Advisor: It’ll be every Wednesday at 5 PM in the library study room.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the meeting?
questions.explain: 此會議的目的是討論生物學。

questions.q: Where will the study group meet?
questions.explain: 學習小組將在圖書館學習室舉行。

announcement.transcript: Attention students! There will be a campus-wide clean-up day this Saturday. Join us at 9 AM at the main quad. Supplies will be provided, and refreshments will be available for all volunteers. Let’s work together to keep our campus beautiful!

questions.explain: 這個公告是關於清理活動的。

questions.q: When will the clean-up day take place?
questions.explain: 清理活動將在這個星期六舉行。

talk.transcript: Today, we are going to discuss the concept of photosynthesis. This process occurs in plants, algae, and some bacteria, where sunlight is converted into chemical energy. Specifically, chlorophyll in the chloroplasts captures sunlight, which is then used to transform carbon dioxide and water into glucose and oxygen. This process is vital not only for the plants themselves but also for life on Earth, as it produces the oxygen we breathe and serves as the foundation of the food chain.

questions.explain: 光合作用是植物中的一個過程。

questions.q: What do plants convert during photosynthesis?
questions.explain: 植物在光合作用過程中轉換二氧化碳和水。
葉綠素的作用是吸收陽光。
光合作用的重要性在於它產生氧氣、創造能量並幫助植物生長。
